name: Eastman Kodak Company
summary: Eastman Kodak Company focuses on the commercial print and advanced materials and chemicals businesses worldwide. The company operates through three segments: Print, Advanced Materials and Chemicals, and Brand. The Print segment provides digital offset plate offerings and computer-to-plate imaging solutions; digital printing solutions; press systems and components under the PROSPER brand name, as well as print inks and primers under the KODAK OPTIMAX, KODACHROME, and KODAK EKTACOLOR brand names; and PRINERGY, a workflow production software that is used by customers to manage digital and conventional print content from file creation to output.
